description: House of Prayer by Melorna is a collaborative Christian prayer network inside ChatGPT. People can anonymously request prayer, carry another person's prayer, review their own activity, and read or share moderated answered-prayer testimonies. Identity and contact details are never exposed, and content is previewed before any confirmed submission.
